_inarow.CANNOT_PASS: You may not pass for the first two moves after the opening phase.
_inarow.CANNOT_SWAP: You may not swap colours at this time.
_inarow.CENTRE_OFFCENTRE: You must place your first stone in the centre of the board in the normal opening.
_inarow.EXCESS: You have placed too many stones. You may only place 1 stone.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS: Select an intersection to place a stone.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_CENTRE1: Place your first stone in the centre of the board.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_LONGPRO1: Place your first stone in the centre of the board.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_LONGPRO3: Select an intersection to place a stone. Your move must be at least four intersections away from the centre of the board.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_PRO1: Place your first stone in the centre of the board.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_PRO3: Select an intersection to place a stone. Your move must be at least three intersections away from the centre of the board.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_SWAP1ST1: Select an intersection to place a stone. The opponent has the option to swap colours on the next turn.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_SWAP1ST2: You may place a stone to continue as player 2, or pass to swap colours to play as player 1.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_SWAP5: Select an intersection to place a stone, or pass to swap colours.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_SWAP21: Place three stones on the board
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_SWAP22: You may do one of (1) place a single stone to continue as player 2, (2) pass to swap colours to play as player 1, or (3) place two more stones and allow the opponent to decide to play as player 1 or player 2.
_inarow.INITIAL_INSTRUCTIONS_SWAP23: You may place a stone to continue as player 1, or pass to swap colours to play as player 2.
_inarow.LONGPRO_RESTRICTION_FIRST: You must place your first stone in the centre of the board in the long pro opening.
_inarow.LONGPRO_RESTRICTION_THIRD: Your third stone must be at least four intersections away from the centre of the board in the long pro opening.
_inarow.NO_MOVELIST: Move list not available during this opening move. Click on the board to place stones.
_inarow.PRO_RESTRICTION_FIRST: You must place your first stone in the centre of the board in the pro opening.
_inarow.PRO_RESTRICTION_THIRD: Your third stone must be at least three intersections away from the centre of the board in the pro opening.
_inarow.SELF_CAPTURE_FORBIDDEN: In this variant, you may not make a placement that results in a self-capture.
_inarow.SWAP2_CAPTURE: This placement will result in a capture.
_inarow.SWAP21_EXCESS: You have placed too many stones. You may only place 3 stones.
_inarow.SWAP21_one: Place 1 more stone on the board.
_inarow.SWAP21_other: Place {{count}} more stones on the board.
_inarow.SWAP22_EXCESS: You have placed too many stones. You may only place 2 stone.
_inarow.SWAP22_PARTIAL: Complete the move to continue as player 2, or place another stone on the board to allow the opponent to decide to play as player 1 or player 2.
